column1: Purpose: See how your sales process is performing by week and by month. Enter a Period Start date to add a new row, everything else fills in on its own.
1. Add a new week or month by entering a Period Start date in column A. Every other column fills in on its own from the Sales Call Database.

2. Close Rate is based on qualified calls that actually happened, not every call you booked. No-shows and unqualified prospects aren't counted, so the number shows how well you close people who could realistically buy.
3. Show Rate, Qualification Rate, Offer Rate, and Offer Close Rate show you where your sales process is actually breaking down.
